source: NOAA Integrated Global Radiosonde Archive (IGRA) v2 Station RPM00098433 (Tanay)
description: Multi-tier atmospheric wind profile capturing directional shear during the 12 January 2020 Taal subplinian eruption.
disclaimer: Contextual reference overlay - not a computed result of the ash model.

levels.note: Surface to boundary layer: blows toward WSW across San Nicolas, Agoncillo, and Laurel
Lower troposphere: blows toward West across western Batangas caldera rim
Mid troposphere: turns toward NW across Tagaytay Ridge and southern Cavite
Upper troposphere: strong advection toward NNE across Laguna, Rizal, and eastern Metro Manila
Plume umbrella / tropopause: fast advection toward NE across Metro Manila, Bulacan, and Central Luzon
